About the player
Simply paste any M3U URL or upload an M3U playlist file to initiate streams directly on our free IPTV web player. It's an excellent tool for testing M3U files and enjoying live HLS TV UHD, FHD, HD, or SD streams on any browser-equipped device. Utilize our IPTV player for trial line testing or as your primary default stream player. There's no need for downloading IPTV apps, VLC, or any other software, as our system operates seamlessly in any web browser.

Our Exceptional PlasmaX

Much like other IPTV applications or players, our platform provides all the essential features needed to enjoy live streams online right through your web browser. The unique advantage of our PlasmaX is the elimination of the need to download any apps, software, or browser extensions. It boasts full compatibility across various web browsers and operating systems (Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, etc.) alongside an intuitive user interface.

Most IPTV providers furnish you with an M3U playlist. Our player allows you to either copy and paste a single channel or upload the entire file, facilitating channel play from the auto-generated IPTV playlist menu.

Frequently asked questions

Think of our online TV player like a magic TV box, but without the box! Usually, to watch shows from special TV services (called IPTV), you need to get an app from places like Google Play or iTunes, or download special programs on your computer like KODI or VLC. But with our online TV player, you don’t need to download anything! It’s like a TV station right in your internet browser, like Chrome or Firefox.

When you get a list of shows (called an m3u file) from your IPTV company, you can just tell our online player about it, and it will show all your shows right in your browser. It’s like telling it where to find your favorite cartoons and movies, and it does all the hard work for you. The cool part? All of this stays only on your computer, and nobody else can see it.

Our online TV player can help you check if the list of shows from your IPTV company works right. It’s also great for watching live TV. It’s handy especially if your phone or tablet is full and has no space for new apps, or if you have an older gadget that doesn’t understand m3u files. As long as your gadget can use the internet and open websites, you can use our online TV player to watch all your shows.

So, it's like having a magic TV without needing any extra stuff, just your regular internet!

Watch Now

We've made it super easy for you to watch your favorite shows online. Our player has two choices: 'IPTV Playlist URL' or 'IPTV File'. Your IPTV company should give you a web address (URL) or a playlist file that ends with .m3u. If it ends with .m3u8 or .ts, you should ask your IPTV company for the .m3u version. You could try changing the ending to .m3u, but this usually doesn't work. It's best to ask your IPTV company for the right playlist file.

Once you have your .m3u playlist file or URL, put the file or type the URL into the right box on the player page and click "Watch". You will see all your shows on the left side, click or tap on one to watch it. Inside the video, you have simple controls like “Stop”, “Volume”, and “Full Screen” to help you watch easily. If you want to change to a different show, click "Stop" first, or you might have two shows playing at once, which can be confusing!
